spans.s: (ahirī,) ahrīka, ahirīka, adj. (= Pali ahirīka; neg. to hrī plus -ka; in Skt. Lex. ahrīka only = a Buddhist!), shameless: ahirīkāś (mss. ahīrikāś) ca bhavanti Mv 〔i.110.8〕 (prose); ahrīkeṇa Jm 〔98.19〕 (prose); ahirīko anotrapo Mv 〔iii.11.4〕 (vs; here used of a very ugly man, without other evident cause for the epithet); in Ud 〔xx.5〕 oldest ms. ahirī (Bhvr.), later ms. ahrīko (Sktizing).
āhrīkya, nt. (cf. Pali ahirika, ˚īka, adj., and sometimes nt. noun), immodesty, shamelessness; associated with anapatrāpya; Mvy 〔1971〕 ˚yam; stem ˚ya- Śikṣ 〔105.8〕; Bbh 〔14.25〕; 〔223.10, 11〕.
